Method of Attack: Malicious code bundled to prompt users to connect cryptocurrency wallets via phishing popups
Injected UI and code from official cryptocurrency wallet SDKs to steal access to victims' crypto wallets and drain assets
Impacted Systems: Users of these websites with cryptocurrency wallets (MetaMask, Exodus, Coinbase, etc.)
Attack Vector: Supply chain attack via compromised developer access token
Automatic distribution through third-party CDNs without version pinning
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing transaction resulting in loss of 10 BTC (~$723,436)
